name: Teen Auto Workshop
what_you_do: Teens learn basic car care on a car from the museum. They learn shop safety and tools. They also learn to find simple problems, change a tire and change oil.
who_can_apply: The page header says ages 13 to 19 and the FAQ says ages 15 to 19, so ask which applies. Sign-up is required and seats are limited.
pay_detail: Free to join. Museum admission is required.
duration: One session on select Saturdays, 10 am to 2 pm
deadline_text: No dates are scheduled. The page says next event to be announced.
how_to_apply: Fill out the sign-up form on the Teen Auto Workshop page when a date is posted. Adults who bring a teen under 18 must stay in the museum.
notes: A one-day workshop, not a job. Check the page for the next date.
